title: SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys
abstract: arXiv:2609.35629v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context, contiguous SANTA++ at S=1024 retains 95-98% of dense aggregate scores on LongBench v2, HELMET RAG, and RULER using 28-31% logical KV access

translated_title: SANTA++：通过代表性键进行注意力采样
translated_abstract: 注意力通常集中在上下文中的一小部分标记上，但哪些标记重要会随查询的不同而变化。为了利用这种动态变化的结构，我们提出了 SANTA++，这是一种无需训练的随机注意力方法，它使用代表性键进行内存高效的选择，而无需扫描整个键值（KV）缓存。缓存的键被组织成多个“团队”（分组），查询对每个团队中的一个代表性键进行评分，以决定采样哪些团队。我们在被采样的团队内计算精确的注意力分数，并根据每个团队被纳入概率的倒数重新加权其贡献。这种重要性采样修正可以估计整个缓存上的注意力，采样预算让我们可以在内存读取量和精度之间进行权衡。在 32K 上下文长度的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，S=1024 的连续 SANTA++ 在 LongBench v2、HELMET RAG 和 RULER 上仅使用 28-31% 的逻辑 KV 访问量，就保留了 95-98% 的稠密聚合分数。
tldr: SANTA++ 是一种无需训练的随机注意力方法，通过将 KV 缓存分组并用代表性键进行重要性采样，仅访问 28-31% 的 KV 缓存即可保留 95-98% 的稠密注意力性能，显著降低长上下文推理的内存开销。
en_tdlr: SANTA++ is a training-free stochastic attention method that samples attention through representative keys, retaining 95-98% of dense attention accuracy with only 28-31% logical KV access, thereby significantly reducing memory costs for long-context inference.
